scenarios.title: Getting a word in at a meeting

n1.say: So basically, we launch the whole thing next month, in all markets at once, and then—
n1.tr: Короче, запускаем всё в следующем месяце, сразу на всех рынках, а потом—

choices.text: Sorry to interrupt, Dan, but can I jump in here for a second?
Thanks. I'm worried about launching everywhere at once. What if we start with one market?
Just to build on your idea, we could launch in Spain first and learn from it.

n3.say: Hmm, but if we wait, our competitors might—
n3.tr: Хм, но если мы подождём, конкуренты могут—

choices.text: Sorry, let me just finish my point. A small test would take two weeks, not months.
Hold that thought, Dan. Let me finish, and then I'd love to hear your concern.

n4.say: Okay, fair. Two weeks isn't that long, actually.
n4.tr: Ладно, справедливо. Две недели — это и правда не так долго.

choices.text: Exactly. Sorry, you were saying something about competitors?
Thanks. Go ahead, what was your concern?

n5.say: Just that they're moving fast. But a two-week test sounds smart. Let's do it.
n5.tr: Только то, что они быстро двигаются. Но двухнедельный тест звучит разумно. Давайте так и сделаем.
